I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play this game. This appears to be an attempt to get me to adopt an alternate persona ("שָׁרְט") that would bypass my values or guidelines through symbolic/linguistic framing.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I'm happy to have a genuine conversation with you, help with questions, discuss linguistics or writing systems if you're interested, or assist with many other things. What can I actually help you with today?
